Only one tag and one counselor physically exercised; T02 compile only.
New backup/provisioning guard paths reviewed; full flash erase was not repeated on already-provisioned boards.
Hardware secure-boot eFuses and flash encryption disabled; unpaired management and unauthenticated business frames.
Buddy pairing, external sensors and Wi-Fi/cloud remain unimplemented.
